Product description

The Realme P4 Lite smartphone combines style and durability in one sleek package. Featuring 4GB of RAM and 128GB of storage, this device offers ample space for your apps, photos, and files whilst ensuring smooth performance for everyday tasks. The stunning Sea Blue finish adds a touch of elegance to your mobile experience. What truly sets this smartphone apart is its military-grade shock resistance, featuring ArmorShell Tough Build technology that can withstand drops from up to 1.8 metres. This P4 Lite stays strong and resilient even during life's toughest moments, making it an ideal companion for those with active lifestyles. The device showcases a modern design with a dual-camera setup and a vibrant display that brings your content to life. Whether you're capturing memories, streaming videos, or staying connected with loved ones, the Realme P4 Lite delivers reliable performance wrapped in a protective build that's ready for whatever comes your way.
